item.text:
Implemented the Rust project in [Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml), with the root entry at [test20.rs](/output/test20.rs) and shared modules in [src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs), [src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs), and [src/score.rs](/output/src/score.rs). It uses only `std`, parses argv through `std::env::args()`, preserves the C++ default/clamp behavior, and matches the provided executable’s observable `stoi`-style success/failure behavior.

Built artifacts are `/output/test20` from `rustc --edition=2021 test20.rs -o test20` and `/output/target/release/test20` from `cargo build --release`. I also ran `cargo test` and compared outputs against `/workspace/dataset/test20_executable` for default, `0 1 2 3 4 5 -1 6 10 +3 4abc ' 4'`, plus invalid cases like `abc`, `--1`, and a large out-of-range integer.
